source: MediaTek proprietary Android 15 IMS payload, with the previously integrated dependency bundle, receiver/video compatibility patch and LineageOS TelephonyMetrics compatibility class
acquisition: The exact APK is a tracked mainline Git blob in this directory. A checkout or Git bundle contains the complete build input; no archive/hybrid directory, old checkout or assembled system image is required.
signing: android_app_import signs this input with the selected product platform certificate. No private signing key is stored here.
rebuild_limitation: The original dependency-bundling recipe and exact unmodified stock APK provenance have not been recovered. This is an explicitly retained proprietary prebuilt, not a claim of a complete stock-to-IMS source build.
runtime_acceptance: Unverified on the candidate with the IMS feature declaration; registration, calls and messages require separate device evidence.
